actual_scope: Prove the exact ordinary Sylvester/Stein displacement rank and minimum lower-times-upper Toeplitz generator count for lexicographically flattened tensors of normalized shifted Gaussian sections and their inverses.
scope_change_reason: The initial analytic_recovery investigation found that the one-axis transfer, fine-grid inverse and source-first recovery obligations had existing scoped packages. The complete serial budget motivated checking a proposed grouped use of the retained shallow ordinary Toeplitz formula. This package proves a scoped representation obstruction rather than discharging analytic_recovery.
bottleneck_link: A direct constant-term ordinary displacement transplant cannot implement the proposed tensor grouping: its exact generator count is 2T/n_fast. Different grouped circuits and the full physical recovery interface remain open. This is a side result informing analytic_recovery, not a complete supplier or theorem.
stop_rule: Stop after the all-size boundary-minor proof, bounded exact failure controls, source and overlap checks, and explicit scope limitations. Do not infer a general runtime lower bound or expand a finite search.
